auto_close_message: This reminder thread is now closed. Call {{callback_number}} if you need anything else.

post_chat_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_chat_analysis_data.description: Outcome of the SMS reminder thread. confirmed = the person replied confirming; reschedule_requested = the person asked to change the appointment; cancel_requested = the person asked to cancel; opt_out = the person asked to stop texts; no_reply = no response; other = anything else.

post_chat_analysis_data.name: sms_opt_out_requested
post_chat_analysis_data.description: True if the person replied STOP, QUIT, END, REVOKE, OPT OUT, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE, or otherwise asked not to be texted.

post_chat_analysis_data.name: phi_beyond_scheduling_mentioned
post_chat_analysis_data.description: True only if the person wrote health information beyond scheduling, asked about a balance or billing, or sent an SSN or insurance member id.
